_comment: "While this is DEFENDING, when it's put into your graveyard from the arena, turn IT face-down." The gate was IN_COMBAT + CONTROLS_ATTACK_ACTION, which is not the same question -- IS_DEFENDING_CARD asks it directly. REF_EXISTS/FLIP_REF resolve a NAMED REF an earlier effect stored, and "self" is not a ref, so the ref fell back to its default ("chosen"), which nothing had set: the condition was false and the flip flipped nothing. "self" is now a recognised spelling in the ref family, and the vacuous REF_EXISTS gate is gone.
